In [[3640 BBY]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] '''captain''' was present in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Nar Shaddaa spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] during the engagement between [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] and the forces of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Morbo]]. He was worried about the damage caused to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] endured by the fighting.
